name: FEASIBILITY / LIMIT TEST (2026-09-25): Emerald Hill act 1, a 416-px enclosed tunnel (one screen + 96 px; the landed act's is 832), then the opening of Chemical Plant act 1
note: A SEPARATE test clip; s2_ehz_cpz (the landed act) is unchanged. This clip was 640 px with no engine code (commit 5e720fe1); the owner then asked for the limit ("we can make this connector test even shorter I think for clip-short"). The owner, 2026-09-25: "let's make the tunnel slightly longer than a screen, I want to limit test." Research: docs/research/2026-09-25-shorter-connector.md. Identical to the 640-px version except the tunnel is 416 px (x 10976..11391), Chemical Plant starts at x 11392, and crossing_overrides also counts Z1 on the screen. WHY 416. What must fit inside the tunnel is the palette swap (SNAP: 1 frame) and the background repaint of the rows the screen shows; since 2026-09-25 a one-plane background is swept by DMA from ROM, BG_WIPE_DMA_ROWS = 14 rows a frame, so the 29 visible rows take ceil(29/14) = 3 frames. Z2 therefore needs CAM_SCREEN_HALF_W 160 + CAM_MAX_X_STEP 16 x 3 = 208 px each side of the mid-tunnel crossing, 416 in all, crossing at x 11184. Z1 on the tile cache (632 px) would forbid it; its subject is the palette ON SCREEN and the cache's margin columns are never displayed, so this clip counts the screen (40 cells; gap here 52).

crossing_overrides.why: LIMIT TEST of the connector length. SNAP: inside the tunnel the screen draws nothing from CRAM lines 1-3 (tools/crossing_witness.py --scan counted 0 such pixels on every in-flight frame), so an instant swap there is invisible. CO_RESIDENT: EHZ's 141 and CPZ's 237 background tiles share 2, so both fit the 376-tile BG arena (using the band reserve a clip act never uses) and a crossing overwrites no tiles. ZONE_SEPARATION = screen: Z1's own docstring says it protects the palette on screen, and it counts the 80-column tile-cache window, which is 20 columns wider than the screen on each side; cells in those margins are streamed but never displayed. Counting the screen instead (no two zones closer than SCREEN_WIDTH) keeps the protection and drops the margin; Z2's crossing walk still holds the exact screen geometry.

unpainted_remainder.why: THE LAST 896 PX OF THE ACT ARE UNPAINTED, x 13440..14335: the act is grid_w 7 x SECTION_SIZE 2048 = 14336 px (Emerald Hill 10976 + tunnel 416 + Chemical Plant 2048 = 13440 > 12288, so it cannot be 6 sections), and Chemical Plant's clip is its first 2048 px as in s2_ehz_cpz. Past x 13440 there is no art and no collision: a player who runs off the end of Chemical Plant's clip falls. The tunnel (x 10976..11391) is painted art on every column. Two-sided: clip_reachability.py refuses if the painted world ends anywhere else.

donor_bottom_boundary.note: each donor level's own bottom y (s2_donor.level_size); Chemical Plant is pasted 256 px lower, so its boundary would sit at y=2080 in this act

unbounded_fall.why: THE ACT HAS NO BOTTOM, as in s2_ehz_cpz. 1632 painted columns have air below their LAST landing surface: Emerald Hill's 1324, the tunnel's 52 (416 px / 8), and Chemical Plant's 256. The other 48 are Emerald Hill's two pits, counted in floorless_columns instead. THE COUNT IS THE CHECK.

floorless_columns.why: EMERALD HILL ACT 1'S OWN TWO BOTTOMLESS PITS, x 4672..4863 and x 9472..9663, exactly as s2_ehz_cpz declares them. Neither the tunnel nor Chemical Plant's first 2048 px adds one. Plane B stays informational (unreachable: no crossover mark).

clips.unaligned_dst_reason: x: Chemical Plant starts where the 416-px tunnel ends (11392 = 10976 + 416), which is not a section boundary: act section 5 holds Emerald Hill's crop end, the tunnel and Chemical Plant's first 896 px. y: lowered 256 px so its start floor (a full block at y=512, s2disasm startpos/CPZ_1.bin) meets the tunnel's floor at y=768, exactly as in s2_ehz_cpz; 256 is a multiple of R12's 16-px collision quantum, so the paste moves art and collision together.
